churn_resistance.rationale: A framework or API upgrade would touch very few files thanks to the single data module and typed view models, but the any-typed data layer, no-op validators and the bespoke not-found path are the kind of seams that will need rework.

findings.issue: type Json = any types the entire data layer, so API shape changes surface as runtime undefined bugs
findings.suggestion: Define minimal interfaces for the PokeAPI resources used and type apiGet<T> per endpoint

findings.issue: Every server fn uses a pass-through .validator((d) => d), so input validation never happens
findings.suggestion: Validate with a real schema (e.g. zod) or drop the validator and annotate the handler input

findings.issue: Not-found is rendered from null loaderData in four routes instead of throwing notFound(); no HTTP 404 status, dead root notFoundComponent, four copies of the head fallback
findings.suggestion: Call throw notFound() from the loader and let a single defaultNotFoundComponent render it

findings.issue: Hand-rolled requestAnimationFrame hash scroll duplicates router-core's built-in hash scrolling and only runs on mount
findings.suggestion: Rely on the router's built-in hash scroll (or subscribe to router state if the initial-load case still misbehaves)

findings.issue: Upstream fetches have no AbortController or timeout, so a stalled API stalls SSR indefinitely
findings.suggestion: Wrap fetch in an AbortSignal.timeout and treat aborts as errors

findings.issue: IDs are parsed with a hand-rolled regex instead of the URL platform API
findings.suggestion: Use new URL(url).pathname and parse the trailing segment

findings.issue: srvx is required by the production npm start script but declared as a devDependency
app/dist (vite build output) is not gitignored, risking committed build artifacts
Unused #/* imports map and tsconfig #/*,@/* alias paths; every import is relative
findings.suggestion: Delete the unused alias config or actually use it

findings.issue: found: true is declared on four view models but never read by any component
findings.suggestion: Remove the field and the null-vs-found ambiguity alongside adopting notFound()

summary: This app is squarely on the current stable generation of TanStack Start: deps pinned to the npm latest releases (react-router 1.170.46, react-start 1.169.4, TS 7, Vite 8, srvx 1.0.8), current APIs throughout (shellComponent, createServerFn validator/handler, validateSearch/loaderDeps, splat not-found), and a minimal, non-redundant dependency set with the data layer isolated behind one module and typed view models. It ages slightly less well at the seams: an any-typed API layer, no-op pass-through validators, and a bespoke null-based not-found path that bypasses the framework's notFound() helper. Solid accept for forward-thinking; the fixes are small and localized.

apis.replacement: throw notFound() from loaders instead of null loaderData + per-route NotFound render
vite build output (dist/server/server.js) served by a fetch-handler runtime such as srvx — which is what this app already does
